title: Beta Blood
body:
**This mod was inspired by the [Blood n' Particles](https://modrinth.com/discover/mods?q=blood%20n%20paticles) mod.**
# Features
This client-side multiplayer friendly modifcation adds blood into your game.
All entities bleed including yourself when taking damage. Blood splatters onto the ground, the walls and spreads over blocks they die over. Blood dries up and eventually disappears, letting blood-shed continue.
